content:
nina: Quick sync: I opened a small PR to unify the streaming + pagination examples across py/ts/go. There's a subtle regressing behavior in Go where an empty trailing page is emitted; we should document the expected semantics and add a small test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4388

omar: Saw that. The Go example used to return io.EOF immediately; now our iterator yields an empty slice for the final page. That broke one of the internal examples in platform-examples.

tia: For Python I updated the async streaming snippet to use `async for msg in client.stream_messages(...)` instead of the old callback style. Also swapped `next_cursor` -> `cursor`.

jun: I have a small TS tweak: use `for await (const chunk of client.stream({ model, cursor }))` and demonstrate `withRetries` wrapping. Also add `@sdk:2.1.0` in the example caption.

nina: Good. Questions: 1) Should we note the Go trailing empty page as "by design" for now, or patch the runtime to suppress it? 2) Do we add a compatibility snippet for v1 users?

omar: Runtime fix is non-trivial and could affect latency. Let's document and add a compatibility helper in docs (tiny snippet that drops empty pages). That way customers have a migration path.

jen: Can we include a one-liner in Go docs: `if len(page.Items) == 0 { continue }`? Keep it explicit. Also add a minimal unit test in examples/go/stream_test.go that asserts no empty pages are observed when using the helper.

nina: Agreed. I'll add the helper and the test. Tia, Jun, can you both update your PRs to reference the helper and add a short migration note like: "If upgrading, you may see an empty trailing page; use the helper `DropEmptyPages` for parity with previous SDK behaviour." Max 2 lines.

tia: I'll add the note and change the py snippet to show both sync and async variants side-by-side.

jun: TS PR updated with helper link and caption target. Also swapped the old retry middleware for `withRetries({ retries: 3 })`. Previews: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4388-ts

docs-bot: deploy preview for branch docs/4388 built successfully 44d https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4388 (status: success)

omar: I added the Go helper `docs/examples/go/helpers.go` with docs comments and a short example. Pushed branch `docs/go/iterate-polish-4389`. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4389

jen: Linter found one formatting nit in the Python example (two-space indent in the fenced code block). Fixed and pushed.

nina: Excellent. After merges, please add an item to the release notes: "Snippet updates: streaming + pagination unify cursor/limit naming; added DropEmptyPages helper; examples target SDK >= 2.1.0." Keep it under the "Docs" section.

jun: One final ask: can docs search map the old term `next_cursor` -> new `cursor` so links and search results still surface older docs? That'll help support.

omar: I'll add a redirect and a small search alias in Algolia config.

nina: Thank you all. Follow-ups: QA to run snippet compile checks across languages, ops to notify a few customers on v1 behaviour change, and product to sign off release-note wording. I'll create tasks in Linear.

docs-bot: All PR previews built: 4388, 4389, 4390.

jen: Thanks team — merging after one final smoke run. :rocket:
